Sandbox_DynamicTrading.AllowHardcoreEven: If enabled, negative events like Famine, War, and Inflation can occur.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.AllowMetaEvents_t: If enabled, long-term world condition events can activate based on their conditions.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.AllowSeasonalEven: If enabled, events like Harvest (Autumn) and Deep Freeze (Winter) can occur.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditAmbushChanc: Chance for each eligible ambush check to spawn a bandit group near an active player.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditAmbushCoold: Minimum in-game hours between random bandit ambushes on the server.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditAmbushDiffi: Controls random ambush group size. 1 = one bandit, 5 = five bandits.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditHouseRoamer: Chance for each bandit roamer dispatch check to start a new occupied-house encounter when the faction is below its active roamer cap.
Percentage of alive Bandits faction members that are eligible to be selected for house-roamer runs.
Maximum percentage of alive Bandits faction members that can be active as house roamers at the same time.
Maximum tile distance from an active player when choosing a house/building for a Bandit roamer site.
Minimum tile distance from an active player when choosing a house/building for a Bandit roamer site.
How many in-game hours Bandit roamers hold a chosen house/building before abandoning the site and leaving the run.
How many in-game hours Bandit roamers spend traveling to and from their occupied-house encounter site.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BanditRaidPartyPe: Percentage of resting hostile faction members that can join a raid, capped by Bandit Ambush Difficulty.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.BuildingMaterialM: Scales the material requirements used by faction building and upgrade systems.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.CategoryInflation: How fast prices rise when players buy out a specific category (Supply and Demand).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ColonyWealth_tool: Sets the colony wealth baseline used for faction economies and trader budget calculations.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.DisableNightScanG: If enabled, the radio scanner will be capable of acquiring trader signals at night (10PM to 5AM) instead of just static.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.EnableBanditAmbus: Allows no-base hostile bandit groups to ambush players and demand money or items. Debug/admin spawning still works when disabled.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.EnableBanditHouse: Allows true Bandits faction members to run dedicated house-roaming danger encounters instead of using normal trader trade runs.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.EventChance_toolt: Probability of an event starting when the frequency check occurs.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionConsumptio: Global multiplier applied to faction resource consumption during simulation.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionDailyConsu: Multiplier for daily food and meds consumption. Higher values make factions harder to sustain.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionDeathThres: How many days a faction can go without food before members start dying rapidly.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionFlashMaxAc: Maximum number of concurrent faction flash-event slots per faction.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionFlashMinAc: Minimum number of faction flash-event slots reserved per faction. Full multi-event logic is applied in the event-system runtime.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionGrowthChan: Daily chance for a stable faction to recruit a new member if recruits are available.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionRespawnCha: Daily chance for a new faction to arrive in a town if the number of existing factions is below the limit.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.FactionStartPop_t: Initial number of members in a generated faction.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.GlobalRecruitCoun: Total number of new wanderers available for all factions to recruit each day.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.IndependentSpawnR: The maximum tile distance from an active player that an Independent (Nomadic) or wandering trader can spawn.
The minimum tile distance from an active player that an Independent (Nomadic) or wandering trader can spawn.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.InflationDecay_to:
Percentage of price inflation that recovers every day.
0.1 = 10% Decay.
0.5 = 50% Decay (Fast Recovery).
0.0 = Inflation never decays.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxFactionsPerTow: The maximum number of distinct factions that can exist in a single town at once.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxGameplayLogs_t: The maximum number of gameplay log entries to keep in history.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.MaxLogs_tooltip: The maximum number of recent network logs to keep in history.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCBaseHealthMult: Scales the archetype base HP used by DT NPC custom health. 1.0 = default values, 2.0 = double base HP before skill bonuses.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCDepartureVisib: The minimum number of travel hours remaining before an NPC's departure is broadcasted on the network.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradeEligibleP: The percentage of a faction's roster that is allowed to participate in the automatic trading rotation at all. Player factions still require workers to be manually trade-approved first.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradePopPercen: The maximum percentage of a faction's population allowed to be on a trading mission (Away or Trading status) at once.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradingStayHou: How many hours the NPC stays at the trading location (Trading state).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCTradingWalkHou: How many hours of travel time (Away state) the NPC takes to reach or return from a trading location.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.NPCWeaponDurabili: If enabled, only player-roster NPCs consume weapon durability in combat. World NPCs never use this mechanic.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PriceBuyMult_tool: Adjusts how expensive items are when buying from traders. Higher = More expensive.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PriceSellMult_too: Adjusts how much traders pay you for items. Lower = Less profit.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ProductionMult_to: Global multiplier applied to faction production and economic output.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PublicNetwork_too: If enabled, radio scan results (Success/Failure) are shown to ALL players on the server. If disabled, only the scanning player sees the result.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RadarScanElectric: How much Electricity XP a player earns each time a radar scan successfully discovers a new signal. Keep this low because scanning can happen often.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RarityBonus_toolt: Increases or decreases the likelihood of rare items appearing. Positive values make rare loot more common.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RestockInterval_t: How many days must pass before a trader refreshes their inventory.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ScanCooldown_tool: Real-time minutes a player must wait between scanning attempts.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.SeasonImpact_tool: How strongly seasons affect prices (e.g. Winter making food expensive).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.StockMult_tooltip: Adjusts the amount of items traders have in stock.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TownTraderWanderC: The percentage chance that a town-based trader will decide to wander out of their home town and spawn near an active player instead.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderBudgetPerce: The percentage of the total Colony Wealth that an individual trader will carry on a trading mission as their temporary budget.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMa: Maximum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMi: Minimum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.V2_FlashEventMaxD: Maximum duration for V2 faction flash events before they expire.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.V2_FlashEventMinD: Minimum duration for V2 faction flash events before they expire.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalkieDropChance_: The percentage chance (0-100) that a zombie will spawn with a Makeshift Walkie Talkie on death.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletEmptyChance: Percentage chance a wallet contains nothing but junk.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletJackpotChan: Chance to hit the 'Tax Return' tier, granting max cash + bonus.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMaxCash_too: The maximum amount of money found in a normal wallet. Jackpots can exceed this.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMinCash_too: The minimum amount of money found in a wallet (if not empty).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ZombieThreatMult_: Scales zombie pressure used by the faction simulation.
